title: Core mechanic 1 - Esquiva (Dodge)
description: First of five core mechanics. Move the stick to avoid incoming geometric shapes; survive the timer to win. Win/lose logic in pure C# where possible; prefab uses simple shapes; ships with a MicrogameDefinition asset. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: Player avatar (a simple shape) moves via the stick; one or more hazard shapes move across the play area.
Win condition: survive the time limit without collision; loss on collision. Collision/win evaluation is unit-tested in pure C#.
A MicrogameDefinition asset registers it (verb e.g. '¡ESQUIVA!') and it runs through the sequencer.
Uses only simple geometric shapes (no art assets).
